`carnivora-reference.rds` contains selected results from the unchanged phylter
0.9.12 source at `4d74241169be3882da9d5f08da47bd40604764eb`, generated by
`tools/audit-run.R` using `parallel=FALSE` and seed 42. Its `provenance` field
records the reference commit, input checksum and R/dependency session.

The reference has 94 outliers and 11 accepted-state scores. Initial and final
WR/RV matrices, weights, compromise and projection Gram matrices are stored,
along with exact outlier IDs/order and optimization scores. Gram matrices allow
harmless eigenvector sign changes. Never regenerate this fixture from the
candidate merely to make a failing regression test pass.

For broader old/new comparisons, use the scripts documented in `tools/README.md`.
